notes: Statutory dates, Ontario Municipal Elections Act 1996: voting day is the 4th Monday of October and nomination day is the 3rd Friday of August. field_certified is an explicit editorial flag the maintainer sets to true once nominations close AND the field is confirmed -- NOT derived from the clock, so the field-consistency tier (ADR 0046) never treats the field as final while nominations are still open. viable_field is the endpoint's modelled distinct candidate set, used as the tier's certified field only when field_certified is true. Candidate ids follow the current-cycle poll bundle.
